post.title: Grandma's pancakes
post.body:
My grandma made these every Sunday and they are the best.

Serves 4

**Ingredients:**

* 2 cups flour
* 2 tablespoons sugar
* 1 teaspoon salt
* 2 large eggs
* 1 1/2 cups milk

**Directions:**

1\. Mix the flour, sugar and salt.
2\. Whisk in the eggs and milk.
3\. Cook on a hot griddle until golden.
